words.gloss: those who are incapable of knowing

literal: Those who possess wisdom know what will happen; those who lack wisdom are those who cannot know that.
translation: Those who possess wisdom foresee what is to come; those who lack wisdom are incapable of knowing it.
modern: அறிவு உடையவர்கள் எதிர்காலத்தில் நடக்கப் போவதை அறிவார்கள்; அறிவு இல்லாதவர்கள் அதனை அறிய இயலாதவர்கள் ஆவர்.
explanation: This couplet defines true wisdom as the capacity for foresight. The word 'āva-tu' refers to that which is yet to happen, meaning future events or the consequences of current actions. Wise people can anticipate these outcomes and act proactively. Conversely, those who lack wisdom are described as being completely unable to perceive or prepare for what lies ahead.
